parameters.question: Decision tree classifier for drug response (responder vs non-responder) from SNPs and clinical features, using a 70/30 train-test split. Compare the top 10 feature importances. At least 7 of the 10 highest-ranked features must overlap with the reference set. Importance scores for overlapping features must be within +/-0.05. Row order and column labels may differ.
Compare decision tree test accuracy for drug response prediction (70/30 split). The test accuracy value must be within +/-0.05 of the reference; column naming and label formatting may differ.
